rules.name: cash-refresh-15-legacy-refresh-timing-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT cob_date, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired_amount, premium_amount, expired_fixing, premium_fixing, total_expiry, total_premium FROM dbsystemuat.client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table_cfs WHERE cob_date = :cob ORDER BY client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency

SELECT cob_date, client_code, currency, opening_balance, expired_or_liquidated_cash, premium_paid_or_recd, closing_balance FROM dbsystemuat.client_cash_account_balance_table_cfs WHERE cob_date = :cob ORDER BY client_code, currency

SELECT id, tablename, valuation_date, status_type, status, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM dbsystemuat.status_table WHERE valuation_date BETWEEN :fromText AND :toText AND (tablename LIKE '%cash%' OR tablename LIKE '%netting%' OR tablename LIKE '%fixing%') ORDER BY valuation_date, updated_timestamp

SELECT id, tablename, valuation_date, status_type, status, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM dbsystemuat.status_table WHERE valuation_date IN (:valueDateText, :fromText) AND tablename LIKE '%cfs' ORDER BY valuation_date, updated_timestamp

SELECT cob_date, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired_amount, premium_amount, expired_fixing, premium_fixing, total_expiry, total_premium, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera_backup_04_10.client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND cob_date = :cob ORDER BY client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency

SELECT cob_date, client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency, expired_amount, premium_amount, expired_fixing, premium_fixing, total_expiry, total_premium, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.client_account_cash_balance_fixing_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS' AND cob_date = :cob ORDER BY client_code, derivative_type, product_code, currency
